## What the respondent sees

![The question as the respondent sees it.](../../../docs/question-types/slider-preview.png){width=90%}

## Settings

- **Minimum, maximum and step.** The range and how finely the respondent can place the handle.

## Best practices for research

Label both ends with what they mean. A slider that starts at a value records it as an answer, so check what was moved.

Reference: Dillman, D. A., Smyth, J. D., & Christian, L. M. (2014). *Internet, phone, mail, and mixed-mode surveys: The tailored design method* (4th ed.). Wiley.
